The runner registers these exact node/range choices through the setSourceMappings operation underlying nodes.setSourceMappings. The checkout is read-only; no canvas tools are exposed inside this evaluation session.

Before submission, read each selected range with line numbers that restart for that file (for example, nl -ba one-file.ts). Do not infer range endpoints from search hits or use cumulative numbering across files. Call validate_source_mappings with your complete candidate JSON, inspect any reported errors, and verify corrected ranges against the source before returning the final JSON.
